notes.title: The Golden Route Challenge
notes.content:
Explorers have traveled far and wide to seek the "[b]Golden Carabiner[/b]"... the most elusive gear known to only the most experienced climbers.  Grab your wits, keep your determination, and look everywhere - you'll need to solve climbing puzzles, try new skill moves, and search high as these golden collectables are scattered across the world, hidden amongst the highest peaks.

We are looking for the most accomplished climbers to retrieve them all, and win big prizes... are you up to the challenge?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34751411/a1fc276d5dc29390782e250b99d54822b1369070.png[/img]

[h2]How to Compete [/h2]
Hidden in the new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2071880/Adventure_Climb_VR__Brave_the_Elements_Expansion_Maps/]Brave The Elements[/url] levels are new secret challenging routes that players must discover, the first three players to collect ALL the gear at the end of each route will have the chance to win one of the prizes listed below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34751411/571a6823217159edd2c66015f92f8b9c3cda1a6d.png[/img]

First Place: $250 USD + in-game mention
Second Place:  Mirco Cillia
Third Place: Codes to Free Partner Game on Steam

Keep on climbing,
MXTreality

PS download the DLC from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2071880/Adventure_Climb_VR__Brave_the_Elements_Expansion_Maps/]here [/url]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2071880/Adventure_Climb_VR__Brave_the_Elements_Expansion_Maps/


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Some mesh colliders have been improved to lessen the chance of some holds not being grabbable 
[*] Visual errors fixed on Desert Ridge and Space Station
[*] Improved visibility in multiple areas
[*] Fixed some walkable areas
[/list]

[h1]Rules[/h1]

[b]Eligibility[/b]
The Golden Route Challenge is open to legal residents of the fifty(50) United States and the Districts of Columbia who are at least thirteen (13) and who are accompanied by an adult at the time of completion. The Contest is subject to federal, state, and local laws and regulations

[b]Agreement to Rules[/b]
By participating, the Contestant (“You”) agrees to be fully unconditionally bound by these Rules, and You represent and warrant that You meet the eligibility requirements. In addition, You agree to accept the decisions of MXTreality as final and binding as it relates to the content of this Campaign.

[b]Winner Selection and Notification[/b]
The winners will be selected via steam leaderboard and notified within ten (14) days following the selection of Winner. MXTreality shall have no liability for the Winner’s failure to receive notices due to spam, junk email, or other security settings or for the Winner’s provision of incorrect or otherwise non-functioning contact information. If the Winner cannot be contacted, is ineligible, or fails to claim the prize within 30 days from the time award notification was sent the prize may be forfeited and an alternate Winner selected.

[b]Terms & Conditions[/b]
MXTreality reserves the right to modify, suspend, cancel or terminate in the event that non-authorized human intervention, a bug or virus, fraud, or other causes beyond your control impact or corrupt the security, fairness, proper conduct, or administration of the contest/giveaway.

[b]Winners List[/b]
The names of the winners will be publicly displayed via Steam community leaderboards once the contest has concluded.

notes.title: Improvement Update - August 10th
notes.content:
This update brings tons of game play improvements, easter eggs, UI displays, some new climbing features, off-route options, and secret routes! For those who like the full experience, we begin to add support for new virtual reality peripherals like bhaptics vest and LIV recordings, as well as deeper immersion of the new HapticSol virtual smells (micro cilia), therefore offering you an even more immersive experience.  Keep an eye out for some indicators of some [u]special[/u] features that we will disclose later - nudge nudge wink wink!

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2071880/Adventure_Climb_VR__Brave_the_Elements_Expansion_Maps/]Brave the Elements[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34751411/1f451882e3d78950a9999a9874b8f132a92adb6f.png[/img]

The Ice Peak level sees the most improvements with environmental elements, interactable icicles, snowballs, alternate routes, and more. 

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Achievement pop-up displays
[*] Pause Menu now works with the keyboard 
[*] Added leaderboard to pause menu 
[*] Leaderboard times are now public in the community hub
[*] LIV VR support
[*] Bhaptics support and some effects added
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed intro screen not properly displaying on restart
[*] Achievement bug fixes
[*] Water VFX
[*] Lighting optimization
[*] Cilla updated to detect on startup 
[/list]

Climb on!
MXTreality

notes.title: Season 2 Hotfix - July 18th
notes.content:
With the addition of our new climbing system and route changes, we have reset our old leaderboards for this new season to get an accurate gauge of what is possible time-wise for the level. Moving forward we are looking into ways to improve the grabbing system to make it a bit more accurate and feel better when jumping and when interacting at faster speeds.

Keep on climbing,
MXTreality

[*] Sound effect looping multiple times

[/list]

notes.title: Full game overhaul : Version 2.0
notes.content:
Today's long-awaited update brings a load of new and improved features and systems to the game. We noticed the limitation our old systems had on the player and wanted to provide you with more freedom and ease of access as well as improve performance and the visuals. 

[h3]New Climbing and Movement system![/h3]
With our new dynamic grip system, the hands will now animate to match the object you are holding on. Also, you can now use the thumb sticks to move and rotate on some flat areas of the levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34751411/57029c2ca63e77b3c65a89f1d48b22d69969efd6.png[/img]

[h3]New Lighting improvements [/h3]
Fullying updated render pipeline improving performance on less powerful systems as well as improving overall visuals.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34751411/c67ef88415abadc1aefb9b1e3a2db388f52542bc.png[/img]

[h3]New UI[/h3]
Added quality of life fixes to UI interactions and how they are integrated into the levels with a new pause menu, and checkpoints for better flow in the level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34751411/1a59be62f832101b3cf1c666ddd9e5c342e0ee56.png[/img]

[h3]New DLC Available July 18th! [/h3]
This DLC has five brand new large-scale levels for you to explore and climb.  These levels feature advanced climbing techniques and various difficulties that will challenge even the most advanced climber. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2071880/Adventure_Climb_VR__Brave_the_Elements_Expansion_Maps/]Brave the Elements DLC Store page[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34751411/f613fad780743a866e68c2d40ee7433c372d918c.png[/img]

Keep on climbing,
MXTreality

[h1]Change Log[/h1]

[/list]
